get.summary: Read the webhook settings. The signing secret is never returned.

put.summary: Set, update or clear the webhook that receives generated timetables. Send a blank url to clear it. The signing secret is returned once, here.
Endpoint to update student enrollment data

post.summary: Queue a timetable generation. Returns a job id immediately; the finished timetable is delivered to the school's webhook.

Bulk upload students from a CSV file. Columns: studentMatriculationNumber, studentFirstName, studentLastName, studentEmail, studentLevel, programCode, departmentCode. Upserts by studentMatriculationNumber. Give programCode, or departmentCode for a student without a programme. The name and email columns are optional, a blank cell clears a stored value and a missing column keeps it; a student without a name is shown by matriculation number. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload students from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload sections for one academic period from a CSV file. Columns: courseCode, sectionName, sectionEnrollmentSize, lecturerStaffNumbers (slash-separated), sectionDurationMinutes (total weekly time, a multiple of 5), sectionUnits (optional; blank uses the course's units), eventType (CLASS | LAB, a label only), split (yes | no | maybe, optional, default no: yes splits a 3-unit section 2/3 + 1/3 and a 4-unit section in half; maybe decides on each generation), relatedTo (optional sectionName of the section this one is taught together with, e.g. PHY 107-CSC: this section gets no events of its own and shares that one's, in a room seating both, shown as PHY 101/PHY 107; pairs only), rooms (slash-separated, optional), timeslot (e.g. M(13:00-15:00)/TH(14:00-17:00), optional). One row per section; a section is courseCode + sectionName, and re-uploading it replaces its events and links. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload sections for one academic period from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Send a single test delivery to the configured webhook and report the result.
Endpoint to register a new school.

Bulk upload rooms from a CSV file. Columns: roomNumber, roomBuilding, roomCapacity, roomType (CLASS | LAB | SEMINAR_ROOM | LECTURE_THEATRE). Upserts by roomNumber + roomBuilding. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload rooms from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload programmes from a CSV file. Columns: programCode, programName, departmentCode, programCoordinatorStaffNumber, programLevel (UNDERGRADUATE | POSTGRADUATE), programDuration, programDescription, programStatus (ACTIVE | INACTIVE). Upserts by programCode. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload programmes from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload curriculum entries from a CSV file. Columns: programCode, courseCode, level (LEVEL_100 ... or 100 ...), semester (FIRST | SECOND, optional), isCore (true | false, default true). Upserts by programCode + courseCode. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload curriculum entries from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload lecturers from a CSV file. Columns: lecturerStaffNumber, lecturerFirstName, lecturerLastName, lecturerEmail, departmentCode. Upserts by lecturerStaffNumber. The name and email columns are optional, a blank cell clears a stored value and a missing column keeps it; a lecturer without a name is shown by staff number. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload lecturers from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Endpoint to add student enrollment

Bulk upload enrollments for one academic period from a CSV file. Columns: studentMatriculationNumber, courseCode, sectionName. Students and sections must already exist. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload enrollments for one academic period from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload departments from a CSV file. Columns: departmentCode, departmentName, departmentHeadStaffNumber (optional). Upserts by departmentCode. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload departments from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Bulk upload courses from a CSV file. Columns: courseCode, courseName, courseUnit, courseLevel (LEVEL_100 ... or 100 ...), departmentCode, courseDescription. Upserts by courseCode; courseUnit and courseLevel are required only for new courses. Valid rows are saved; rejected rows are listed with the reason. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.
Bulk upload courses from a JSON array. Rows use the CSV column names. Pass dryRun=true to validate and see the counts without saving.

Headline figures for the dashboard: the current academic period and live counts of courses, lecturers, rooms and students for the caller's school.
The caller's school's most recent activities, newest first. 'limit' is 1-50 and defaults to 10.

delete.summary: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Permanently deletes all of the caller's school data (departments, lecturers, rooms, programmes, courses, curriculum, students, academic periods, sections, events, enrollments, timeslots, activity). The school and its login are kept. Pass confirm=DELETE-ALL-MY-DATA. Returns 404 unless the server runs with TESTING_RESET_ENABLED=true.
Endpoint to delete student enrollment data
